entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Applications seeking permission to file the Special Leave Petitions are granted.
3. Exemption Applications are allowed.
4. The petitioners are expropriated land owners, whose properties have been admittedly acquired by the State of Haryana from time to time.

The acquisition appears to have attained finality but the petitioners are stated to be still in physical possession of the residential/commercial constructions raised before the Notifications under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 were issued.
The petitioners claim that they are still in possession of their structures.

The petitioners are stated to have made representation(s) for the release of the properties in their possession in terms of Governments Policy dated 14092018, which is stated to have been formulated under Section 101A of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act), 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act), 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the High Court has vide impugned interlocutory order dated 14032023 issued directions to the State of Haryana and its authorities to identify lands which were acquired for public purposes.

Thereafter, encroachments are to be identified and removed,
especially on the National Highway, State High Ways, Sector Roads and areas abutting High Ways etc.
The High Court has directed the State Government to submit the status report after complying with its directions.
5. We have heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and perused the material placed on record.

6. In our considered view, the appropriate recourse for the petitioners would be to seek their impleadment before the High Court in the pending Writ Petition and apply for seek suitable modification of the interim directions issued on 14032023.
7. The High Court is requested to accord an opportunity for being heard to the petitioners.

8. The State of Haryana and its authorities are directed to apprise the High Court the fate of the representation(s) said to have been made by the expropriated landowners like petitioners under Section 101A of the 2013 Act.

9. The State Government shall also apprise the High Court the decisions, if any, having been taken on those representation(s) in light of the decision of this Court dated 15072021 in Civil Appeal Nos.27142715/2021 and other connected Appeals (Raghubir Singh & Anr. Etc. vs. State of Haryana & Ors.)
10.

entities.text: Raghubir Singh & Anr. Etc. vs. State of Haryana & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is clarified that we have not expressed any views on the merits of the case.
11. With liberty aforementioned, the Special Leave Petitions are disposed of.
(VISHAL ANAND) (PREETHI T.C.)
ASTT. REGISTRARcumPS COURT MASTER (NSH)
